描述_EN: the three sections on the lid all tell stories related to marriage, so the box was probably used in one of the crucial ceremonies leading up to a wedding. these included the exchange of horoscopes between the families of the bride and groom. astrological charts were important to ensure that the couple's destinies were linked together, for if the signs were unfavourable the marriage was unlikely to succeed. this oblong box is made of carved black lacquer on a red ground. this technique is strikingly reminiscent of the bold outlines of the book illustration that flourished at the time it was manufactured.
描述_ZN: 盖子上的三个部分都讲述了与婚姻有关的故事，所以这个盒子可能是在婚礼前的一个关键仪式上使用。 其中包括新郎和新娘家庭之间的星座交流。 占星图对于确保这对夫妇的命运联系在一起非常重要，因为如果星座不利，婚姻就不可能成功。 这个长方形盒子是由红底黑漆雕刻而成。 这种技术让人惊讶地联想到在制造它的时候，书本插图的大胆轮廓。
